configText:
# The learned pilots' self-play round (RH Aviator A13–A15; TRAINING-CONCEPT M21–M28, SIX 2026-10-29).
# 8 v 8 in Assets/_SCENES/Dogfight Training.unity: one shared "Fighter" brain, blue team 0 and red team 1,
# PPO with ML-Agents self-play (each side learns in turn against frozen older copies of the brain).
# Every number here is AUTHORED, a starting point for the first rounds, not a tuned result.
#
# Auto-train on Play (RH Aviator A18) runs this config when both sides have learning jets, as the rolling run
# "auto-selfplay". By hand (turn auto-train off first; from the project root; mlagents 1.1.0 on Python 3.10.11, CPU PyTorch):
#   In the Editor:   C:/Users/SIX/venvs/mlagents-1.1.0/Scripts/mlagents-learn Training/config/fighter_selfplay.yaml --run-id=fighter-001 --results-dir=Training/results
#                    then press Play in Dogfight Training.
#   Headless build:  add --env=Builds/FighterTraining/FighterTraining.exe --num-envs=4 --no-graphics
# Watch:            C:/Users/SIX/venvs/mlagents-1.1.0/Scripts/tensorboard --logdir Training/results

behaviors:
  Fighter:
    trainer_type: ppo
    hyperparameters:
      batch_size: 2048          # decisions per gradient step; 8 jets × 10 decisions a second fill it in ~26 s of flight
      buffer_size: 20480        # ten batches between updates
      learning_rate: 3.0e-4
      learning_rate_schedule: constant   # self-play: the opponent keeps changing, so the learning rate does not decay
      beta: 5.0e-3              # entropy: keeps it trying new things while kills are still rare
      epsilon: 0.2
      lambd: 0.95
      num_epoch: 3
    network_settings:
      normalize: true           # the senses are scaled to about ±1 already; this takes out what is left
      hidden_units: 256
      num_layers: 2
    reward_signals:
      extrinsic:
        gamma: 0.995            # a horizon of ~200 decisions (20 s): long enough to connect a turn to a kill
        strength: 1.0
    keep_checkpoints: 10
    checkpoint_interval: 500000
    max_steps: 20000000
    time_horizon: 256           # 25.6 s of decisions per trajectory piece
    summary_freq: 20000
    self_play:
      save_steps: 50000         # a snapshot of the brain for the opponents' pool every 50,000 steps
      team_change: 200000       # the learning side swaps every 200,000 steps
      swap_steps: 10000         # the opponent's snapshot changes this often
      window: 10                # the opponent is drawn from the last 10 snapshots …
      play_against_latest_model_ratio: 0.5   # … or, half the time, the latest
      initial_elo: 1200.0

engine_settings:
  time_scale: 20                # the Editor's or the build's clock at 20× (the tick is still 50 Hz of game time)
  target_frame_rate: -1
  capture_frame_rate: 0
  no_graphics: false            # pass --no-graphics for a headless build

checkpoint_settings:
  results_dir: Training/results
scorecard: not measured: the held-out gate is not built
